description: Build with AI: PromptWars is a challenge for anyone who loves building solutions - whether you’re a developer, designer, or a professional with a passion for vibe coding and having big ideas. We're inviting professionals to this prompt-based challenge, where you’ll create solutions by simply prompting and building using AI. Participants will showcase their problem-solving skills and stand a chance to win big prizes. Join us in-person at the Google Office in Gurugram, where you’ll get hands-on experience with Google Antigravity. It’s open for professionals who are passionate about solving problems and experimenting with AI.
